title: Why Do Trump Supporters Continue to Stand By This Lawless, Lying President? This Psychologist Explains
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
With Trump supporters continuing to blindly champion their MAGA leader - even
as he compares himself to Jesus Christ, gets a giant golden statue of himself
at Mar-a-Lago, and says he doesn't think about the financial situations of
Americans "[even a little
bit](http://google.com/search?q=trump+even+a+little+bit+finances&sca_esv=006960b001859e84&sxsrf=ANbL-n51HuLrjklEBBJyE48ZvQBkjErnDQ%3A1779137369138&source=hp&ei=WXsLatXzBdufw8cP6L6rwAc&iflsig=AFdpzrgAAAAAaguJacmrvZ61tyD6kGwhTr2Istq7aHAt&ved=0ahUKEwiVhJGX28OUAxXbz_ACHWjfCngQ4dUDCCo&uact=5&oq=trump+even+a+little+bit+finances&gs_lp=Egdnd3Mtd2l6IiB0cnVtcCBldmVuIGEgbGl0dGxlIGJpdCBmaW5hbmNlc0iKGFAAWM4XcAB4AJABApgBhAOgAY0eqgEJMTMuMTYuMS4xuAEDyAEA-
&sclient=gws-
wiz)" - do you ever wonder what's going on inside their heads?

In a new '**Mehdi Unfiltered ' **interview, **Mehdi** speaks with **Dr. Cindy
Harmon-Jones** , a senior lecturer in the School of Psychology at Western
Sydney University, who recently published a [new academic
study](https://jspp.psychopen.eu/index.php/jspp/article/view/16085) dedicated
to answering that very question.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Harmon-Jones, an expert in cognitive dissonance, tells Mehdi she wanted to
understand why Trump supporters stand by him despite the allegations of sexual
abuse and other criminal behavior. Her study found three common justifications
offered by MAGA movement members.

Mehdi and Harmon-Jones also discuss just how Trump-specific this cult-like
support is, what might convince long-time supporters to finally turn their
backs on the president, and why people fell hook, line, and sinker for this
lawless, lying president in the first place.

"**There is quite a bit of research showing that when people feel like they
're under threat, they will turn to authoritarianism**," Harmon-Jones says,
particularly "**conservatives or right-wing-type people**."
